name: io.github.GeminiGeorge22/cs2-sim
title: CS2 Sim
description: CS2 economy simulator: loss bonus, buy or eco, half simulation.

tools.name: cs2_money_rules
tools.description: FREE CS2 money rules: loss bonus, round rewards, kill rewards. Competitive/Premier economy: start $800, cap $16,000, loss bonus ladder, win/bomb rewards, plant bonus, kill rewards by weapon class. Always free. (free, no payment)

tools.name: cs2_next_round_money
tools.description: FREE CS2 next-round money after a win or loss. Given each player's money, side and loss count, returns everyone's money next round if you win or lose (with plant bonus for T) and the next loss bonus. Always free. (free, no payment)

tools.name: cs2_buy_decision
tools.description: CS2 buy decision: full buy, force or eco. Compares full buy, force and eco for your team money and loss count: who can buy now, how many players can full buy next round after a win or loss, and two rounds out after a loss and eco; gives a plain-language call. Costs $0.001 per call, paid with MPP on Tempo (send an MPP Payment credential in the Authorization header of the MCP request, or call POST https://cs2-sim.fmf-x402.workers.dev/mpp/cs2/buy-decision with mppx). Without payment it returns the price and how to pay; invalid input is never charged.

tools.name: cs2_economy_sim
tools.description: CS2 economy simulator: Monte Carlo of the rest of a half. Seeded Monte Carlo of up to 12 rounds with real money rules and your win-rate assumptions by buy matchup: expected rounds won, chance to win the majority, and per-round full-buy and win odds. Costs $0.003 per call, paid with MPP on Tempo (send an MPP Payment credential in the Authorization header of the MCP request, or call POST https://cs2-sim.fmf-x402.workers.dev/mpp/cs2/economy-sim with mppx). Without payment it returns the price and how to pay; invalid input is never charged.
